name: How to Set Up Google Analytics 4
description: A step-by-step guide to setting up Google Analytics 4 on your website for tracking user behavior and conversions.

step.name: Create a GA4 Property
step.text: Go to analytics.google.com, click Admin, then click Create Property. Enter your property name, select your time zone and currency.

step.name: Set Up a Data Stream
step.text: In the property settings, click Data Streams, then Add Stream. Select Web and enter your website URL and stream name.

step.name: Install the Tracking Code
step.text: Copy the Measurement ID (starts with G-). Add the gtag.js snippet to the <head> section of every page, or use Google Tag Manager to deploy it site-wide.

step.name: Verify Data Collection
step.text: Open your website in a new tab, then check the GA4 Realtime report. You should see at least 1 active user. If not, check the tracking code installation and wait a few minutes.

step.name: Configure Key Events
step.text: Go to Admin > Events and mark important events as key events (formerly conversions). Common key events include form submissions, phone clicks, and purchase completions.
